meta_description:
19K likes, 258 comments - foodpharmer on October 24, 2026: "What’s inside our plant protein? 

Four ingredients:

- Pea Protein Isolate
- Brown Rice Isolate
- Cocoa powder
- Stevia

Our Plant Protein is finally BACK! ❤️ It’s now available on our website and app.

This time, we’ve launched Cocoa instead of Coffee. I had personally admitted that the taste of our previous Plant Protein wasn’t great. But I genuinely like the taste of this new version WAY WAY WAY more!

I’m also really sorry for all the frustration over the last 6 months because of it being out of stock. Thank you for being patient with us.

And as many of you requested, we’ve produced a much larger batch this time, so hopefully we won’t go out of stock again anytime soon!

Really happy to finally have it back. @onlywhatsneeded".
